summary: A candidate answers a mailer by saying plainly that it tells voters something false about them.
realLife: A Florida school board candidate called an opposing mailer deceit and said it was tricking voters into thinking she had said something she had not.
sources: Flagler Live via Yahoo, Flagler school board candidate targeted by outside attack ads and mailers: https://www.yahoo.com/now/straight-deceit-flagler-school-board-090010774.html
inGame: the player's reply moves (deny, disagree, confront) in rival-word, the views engine's record of what the player actually holds on the issue

turns.turn: The mailer is true and the candidate says so
turns.writes: a confess reply and a lost voter

turns.turn: The candidate says nothing and lets it run
